description: Transport controls for the active playback: pause, resume, next, previous, seek (value = seconds), volume (value = 0-100), shuffle (value = on/off), repeat (value = off/context/track).

value.description: Required for seek (seconds from track start), volume (0-100), shuffle (on/off), repeat (off/context/track). Omit for pause, resume, next, previous.

name: playback
title: Control playback
